name: godot_run
description: Run the project or a scene in a separate background Godot for some frames, as a task: the open editor stays usable and a crash there never touches it. Headless by default (the game's scripts run, its output and errors are read from its log); with capture, Godot's Movie Maker writes the frames as PNG images and the first, middle and last frames come back as images (a window of its own; hidden on Windows). It runs a working copy of the open scene (default), the scene as saved (source saved), a scene file, or the project's main scene (scene main). Returns a task: call again with task (and wait_s) for its state, or cancel.

scene.description: A scene file (res://..., relative to the project, or absolute), or main for the project's main scene (default: the open scene).

source.description: For the open scene: copy (as it is now in the editor) or saved (its file).

capture.description: true, or {fps?: 1 to 240 (default 30), size?: [width, height]}: write the frames with Movie Maker.

task.description: A task from an earlier call: its state.

wait_s.description: Wait up to this long for the task to finish (0 to 3600).
